suggested_changes.reasoning: Reducing the learning rate will allow the model to converge slowly and potentially learn more from the imbalanced data. A higher gamma in the FocalLoss makes the model pay more attention to hard, misclassified examples. Increasing the number of epochs will give the model more time to learn from the data. Automatically optimizing the threshold based on F1-score will balance precision and recall, and is a better strategy for imbalanced datasets than a fixed threshold.
